description: This file implements utility functions for managing disk quotas in the Android installd component, including quota mount invalidation, device lookup by UUID, and retrieval of space usage for UIDs, GIDs, and project IDs.

methods.name: FindQuotaDeviceForUuid
methods.description: Finds the device associated with a quota UUID.

methods.name: InvalidateQuotaMounts
methods.description: Clears and repopulates the quota mounts mapping by reading /proc/mounts.

methods.name: IsQuotaSupported
methods.description: Checks if quota is supported for a given UUID.

methods.name: GetOccupiedSpaceForUid
methods.description: Returns the current space occupied by a specific UID on the device associated with the UUID.

methods.name: GetOccupiedSpaceForProjectId
methods.description: Returns the current space occupied by a specific project ID on the device associated with the UUID.

methods.name: GetOccupiedSpaceForGid
methods.description: Returns the current space occupied by a specific GID on the device associated with the UUID.
